rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs meeting 18VAC110-21-120 B or 18VAC110-21-130 B (ACPE, pharmacy-focused Category I CME, Board-approved); 0.5 CEUs = 5 contact hours
rules.new_licensee_rule: Registrations issued on or after July 1 first renew December 31 of the next year.
rules.alternatives: Up to 1 hour for volunteer pharmacy services (1 hour per 3 hours). Extension of up to 1 year on written request.
rules.audit_note: Keep documentation 2 years after renewal; provide on Board request.
rules.notes: Registrations expire December 31 and renew annually; renewal needs an NABP e-profile number.
rules.rule_quote: A pharmacy technician shall be required to have completed a minimum of 0.5 CEUs or five contact hours of approved continuing education for each annual renewal of registration.
